draftBefore.emotion: hungry and looking forward to a break, relaxed and ready to eat
notes: In most of Italy, 'il pranzo' is the main meal in the middle of the day, while 'la cena' is in the evening. However, in some northern regions, people traditionally call the evening meal 'pranzo' and the midday one 'colazione' (though 'colazione' now usually means breakfast).
